data.one_liner: SASL SCRAM authentication implementation in Dart supporting scram-1 and scram-256.
data.what_it_does: Provides Salted Challenge Response Authentication Mechanism (SCRAM) authentication. Manages both scram-1 and scram-256 mechanisms for secure credential handling.
use_when: You need to authenticate against a backend or database using SASL SCRAM.
You are implementing MongoDB or similar database connections requiring SCRAM-SHA-256.
avoid_when: You are using OAuth or social sign-ins.
Your backend relies entirely on standard HTTP bearer tokens or Firebase Auth.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works across multiple platforms including web, mobile, and desktop.
weaknesses: Niche functionality limited to SASL SCRAM protocol.
Minimal documentation and usage examples beyond basic README.
